translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Dhako mariek gero ode,
to dhako mofuwo muko ode gi lwete owuon.
Ngʼat ma wuodhe oriere oluoro Jehova Nyasaye,
to ngʼat ma yorene achach ochaye.
Wuoyo mar ngʼama ofuwo kelone mana goch e ngʼeye,
to dho jomariek bedonegi ragengʼ.
Kama onge rwedhi, dipo bedo nono,
to kama rwath nitiere keyo mangʼeny bedoe.
Janeno ma ja-adiera ok riambi,
to janeno ma hango wach wacho mana miriambo.
Ngʼat ma jasunga nyalo dwaro rieko to ok oyud gimoro,
ngʼeyo tiend wach to biro mayot ne ngʼat ma ongʼeyo pogo tiend weche.
Bed mabor gi ngʼat mofuwo
nimar ok iniyud ngʼeyo tiend wach e dhoge.
Rieko mar jorieko en bedo gi paro ne yoregi,
to fup joma ofuwo en wuondruok.
Joma ofuwo jaro kowachnegi mondo giwe richo,
to ngʼwono iyudo kuom joma kare.
Chuny ka chuny ongʼeyo litne owuon,
to onge ngʼato machielo manyalo bedo e mor ma en-go.
Od ngʼat marach ibiro ketho
to kar dak mar ngʼat makare biro dhiyo nyime.
Nitie yo manenore ne dhano ni nikare,
to gikone otero mana ngʼato e tho.
Kata e kinde mar nyiero, chuny nyalo bedo gi lit,
to mor nyalo gik e kuyo.
Joma onge yie ibiro mi pok moromo gi timbegi,
to ngʼat maber bende pok moromo kode.
Ngʼat mangʼeyone tin thoro yie gimoro amora,
to ngʼat mariek paro gik motimo.
Ngʼat mariek oluoro Jehova Nyasaye kendo okwedo richo,
to ngʼama ofuwo wiye tek kendo omuomore.
Ngʼat ma iye wangʼ piyo timo gik mofuwo,
to ngʼat ma ja-miganga ji mon-go.
Joma ngʼeyogi tin nwangʼo fuwo,
to jomariek irwako nigi ogut ngʼeyo.
Joricho kulore e nyim joma beyo,
to jo-ajendeke e dhorangeye mag joma kare.
Jochan ok dwar kata gi jobutgi,
to jo-mwandu nigi osiepe mangʼeny.
Ngʼatno machayo jabute timo richo,
to ogwedhi ngʼatno mangʼwon gi jogo mochando.
Donge jogo machano marach lal nono?
To jogo machano gima ber yudo hera kendo imiyogi luor.
Tich matek duto kelo ohala,
to wuoyo awuoya maonge tim kelo dhier.
Mwandu jomariek e osimbo margi,
to fup joma ofuwo nyago mana fuwo.
Janeno ma ja-adiera reso ji e tho,
to janeno ma hango wach en jawuond.
Ngʼat moluoro Jehova Nyasaye nigi ohinga motegno,
kendo nyithinde noyud kar pondo.
Luoro Jehova Nyasaye en soko mar ngima,
ma reso ngʼato e obadho mag tho.
Ruoth ma joge ngʼeny ema yudo duongʼ,
to ruoth maonge jogo morito to podho.
Ngʼat ma terore mos nigi winjo,
to ngʼatno ma iye wangʼ piyo nyiso fupe.
Chuny man-gi kwe kelo ngima ni ringruok,
to nyiego towo choke.
Ngʼat masando jochan nyiso achaya ne Jal mane ochweyogi,
to ngʼato angʼata mangʼwon ni jogo mochando miyo Nyasaye luor.
Ka masira obiro, joricho itieko,
to kata e tho ngʼat makare nigi kar pondo.
Rieko odak e chuny ngʼat ma weche donjone,
to kata mana e dier joma ofuwo omiyo ingʼeye.
Tim makare tingʼo oganda malo,
to richo en wichkuot ne ji.
Ruoth mor gi jatich mariek,
to jatich makwodo wich yudo mirimbe.
